question.text: Black-Scholes Model determines option premium based on:

answer.text: Underlying asset price, exercise price, volatility, interest rates, and time to expiry

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists five Black-Scholes inputs: underlying asset price, exercise price, inherent volatility in the asset price, changes in interest rates, and time to option expiry. The Trap: Using only the strike price, only time to expiry, or fund size ignores the other inputs the model relies on; an option premium cannot be derived from any single one of these. Note: Based on Series-XIX-B workbook p.279, which enumerates the five Black-Scholes inputs.
